blocks.title: CLI application
blocks.text: A Command-Line Interface (CLI) application lets users interact with a program through text commands typed in a terminal or command prompt. All the programs in this chapter are CLI applications.

items: Save main.py and greetings.py in the same directory.
Open a terminal or command prompt, go to that directory and run: python main.py
You should see the output: As-Salaam-Alaikum, everyone!

blocks.prompt: Class activity: write calculator.py with add(a, b) and subtract(a, b) and use them in main.py to print 15 + 8 and 25 - 10.
blocks.explanation: calculator.py: def add(a, b): return a + b and def subtract(a, b): return a - b. main.py: import calculator; print(calculator.add(15, 8)) gives 23; print(calculator.subtract(25, 10)) gives 15. Run it with python main.py.

items: CLI apps run from a terminal: python main.py; Python's standard library has hundreds of modules.
